title: Austin Judge Candidate Interviews
summary:
*   A special meeting of a subcommittee focused on the Municipal Court.
*   The primary purpose was to interview candidates for judicial positions at the Municipal Court.
*   Interviews and discussions were conducted in a closed "Executive Session" for personnel matters.
*   No final decisions or votes were taken on any items during this meeting.
